extracted.name: Sweet Fire Rib Rub
extracted.description: Although this homemade spice rub is intended for ribs to be smoked on the barbeque, it's also great on chicken and steaks, as long as there is smoke.
instruction_lines: Mix brown sugar, white sugar, paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, chili powder, black pepper, cayenne pepper, and salt together in a bowl. Store in a sealable container in a cool, dry place.
